messages:
maria.teal: Anyone seen req-id vanish from stdout when we bump LOG_LEVEL=debug + enable OTEL_LOG_HOOK? Repro is intermittent, looks tied to auth retries in sampleapp@v0.12.3. Steps below.

maria.teal: Repro steps:
```bash
export REDWOOD_TELEMETRY=otel
export OTEL_LOG_HOOK=1
export LOG_LEVEL=debug
node examples/sampleapp.js &
# trigger request that will hit auth and retry path
curl -v http://localhost:8000/stream-endpoint
```

maria.teal: Minimal log snippet i saw (plaintext stdout):
`[2025-09-12T18:12:03.456Z] INFO request handled user=alice path=/stream - req_id=<redacted>`
and the structured json line from the same run shows req_id present: `{"ts":"2025-09-12T18:12:03.456Z","level":"info","msg":"request handled","req_id":"r-8f7a","path":"/stream"}`

maria.teal: So when debug + OTEL hook enabled, plaintext lines are redacted or missing req_id intermittently during retries.

sam_sdk: Do you have the node SDK version and whether pino or winston are used? Also paste the small env + package.json dependencies.

maria.teal: node:14/16 mix, SDK: 0.21.1, using pino via our sampleapp starter. deps: "@redwood/telemetry-sdk": "0.21.1", "pino": "7.x"

alex_g: My 2c: sounds like the log hook that enriches pino is running before the otel context with reqId is restored on retry callbacks. Node async_hooks + setTimeout/setImmediate during our auth-backoff can lose the context, so the hook writes a line without the req id. The structured logger path that reads from the local var at write time still gets it sometimes.

ian: Agreed. We saw similar with correlation ids — ordering matters. Quick workaround: initialize telemetry after logger + patch pino to read from telemetry context instead of capturing at logger creation time. Eg:
```js
// bad: logger created before telemetry init
const logger = pino();
initTelemetry();
// good
initTelemetry();
const logger = pino({ hooks: { logMethod (args, method) { args[0].req_id = telemetry.getReqId(); method.apply(this, args); }}});
```

sam_sdk: Nice reproduction, thanks. I'll add an integration test that runs with OTEL_LOG_HOOK=1 and toggles LOG_LEVEL=debug to catch the retry case. Will open a PR to reorder init in the sampleapp and add the test + docs.

maria.teal: Thanks — can you also add a short note in the onboarding quickstart about ordering (telemetry before logger hooks) and mention async_hooks caveat? I hit this while demoing to a customer and it was confusing. :grimacing:

sam_sdk: Yep. PR will be: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/pull/4321 (draft)

dev-bot: CI for PR #4321 queued — tests will run on node 14/16/18 matrix.

ian: If this is a behavioral difference across SDKs (python uses contextvars and works) we should flag it in the SDK parity doc and consider a runtime flag like REDWOOD_TELEMETRY_PERSIST_CONTEXT=1 for node where async_hooks are flaky.

sam_sdk: Added to PR checklist. Will try to get a patch and backport to 0.12.x branch.

maria.teal: Sweet — ping me when draft is ready, i'll validate against our customer repro. Thanks all :+1:
